# FBX

> Apps, automações, portais e agentes em Power Platform, com SAP, Databricks e APIs. 15 projetos com arquitetura, decisões e demo.

FBX is the independent practice of Luigi Funaro (Londrina, Brazil; remote). It designs and builds Microsoft Power Platform solutions (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Copilot Studio, Dataverse, SharePoint, Power BI) and integrations with SAP S/4HANA, Databricks, AWS and REST APIs, plus AI agents and WhatsApp automation (n8n). Languages: Portuguese, English, Spanish. Contact: dev.luigifunaro@outlook.com
